protocol.input_domain: Standardized official UCI HAR inertial windows
protocol.noise: Independent standard-normal draws before RMS scaling per window and channel
protocol.power: Mean square over the 128 time points, including DC
protocol.scaling: Unit-RMS template times clean-window channel RMS times 10**(-snr_db/20)
protocol.sharing: Identical noisy input across all nine checkpoints per level; same template across levels
protocol.postprocess: Cast to float32; no clipping or restandardization
protocol.baseline: Recompute clean scores and confirm against the saved official-test metrics
protocol.comparison: 100 * (clean - noisy) paired within checkpoint, then mean and sample SD over 3 seeds
